selection_basis: Manual review of the original-photograph contact sheets; visible face and representative hairstyle, adequate source resolution, distinct apparent identities, and limited occlusion. Reserves require the same checks before substitution.

Afro.rejection_notes: Obscured faces, sunglasses, distant subjects, or repeated image (21.jpg duplicates 5.jpg).

BowlCut.rejection_notes: Rear/profile framing or cuts that look closer to pixie, crew, or an unrelated short style.

Bun.rejection_notes: Collages/product images, hair bun not visible, severe profile, small face, or a portrait visually very similar to another selected stock model (22.jpg).

CornRows.rejection_notes: Several images show generic long braids without a visible cornrow pattern; some are collages or head-down views. 27.jpg and 28.jpg may repeat the identity in selected 25.jpg, so neither is used for validation.

DreadLocks.rejection_notes: Back/side views, face occlusion, hats, or styles that resemble braids or loose curls rather than locks (24.jpg).

HiTopFade.rejection_notes: Many images are extreme profile, distant, or show a low fade without a clear high top.

PixieCut.rejection_notes: Repeated celebrity identities, side/rear views, or short bobs that blur the pixie label. 27.jpg duplicates SpikyHair/15.jpg byte-for-byte.

PonyTail.rejection_notes: Illustrations/collages, loose hair where the ponytail is not visible, or braids mislabelled as a ponytail. 26.jpg repeats the same celebrity as selected 25.jpg.

SpikyHair.rejection_notes: Some images show ordinary short hair or pixie cuts with little visible spiking; collages and side-only views excluded.

WaistLenHair.rejection_notes: Back views, collages, heavy hats, very small faces, framing that hides the hair length, or celebrity identity repeated in another class (19.jpg versus PonyTail/25.jpg).

not_selected_classes.CurtainedHair: Repeated celebrity/domain examples, soft small portraits, and ambiguous center-part membership.
not_selected_classes.HimeCut: Many photographs show blunt bangs or long hair without clearly distinct hime side locks; only 25 meet the size threshold.
not_selected_classes.FrenchTwist: Many profile or rear views obscure identity and frontal hairstyle evidence.
not_selected_classes.Mohawk: Clear label in some cases, but many source examples are extreme side views or novelty colors; SpikyHair offers more usable frontal variety.
not_selected_classes.Perm: Variable curl patterns overlap Afro or Ringlet; less consistent as a distinct label.
not_selected_classes.Ringlet: Overlaps Perm and has duplicate/illustrative examples.
not_selected_classes.Mullet: Several costume/wig examples and unclear face/hair framing.
not_selected_classes.shag: Overlaps the existing layered style and includes repeated identities plus one truncated file.
